status_meaning.scored: a validation run exists and its scores are in cases/{id}/validation.json; whether it agrees is in the numbers
status_meaning.running: the solve is in progress; no scores yet
status_meaning.not comparable: the engine cannot produce the measured quantity at the measured location: OpenLB at the resolution this hardware runs, FluidX3D without a ground wall function; the measurement behind each is on the Validation page

results.quantity: the thermistor's (tunnel) and the cup anemometer's (field) mean speed over U(500 m) against the model's |U| and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) over its own approach U(500 m) = 9.862 m/s (probed 1100 m upwind of the centre; the imposed U(500 m) is 10 m/s), at the 33 tunnel points (planes at 5, 9 and 20 m) and the 13 field observations of wind from NNW; frame literal
results.normalisation: the thermistor's (tunnel) and the cup anemometer's (field) mean speed over U(500 m), the benchmark's own ratio, against the model's |U| and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) over its own approach U(500 m) = 9.862 m/s (the imposed U(500 m) is 10 m/s); hit rate D = 0.25, W = 0.05 in those units; 33 tunnel points and 13 field observations of wind from NNW; FB is positive when the model is low
notes: One direction of the tunnel's twelve: only wind from NNW was solved, the direction Eddy3D's fixture solves by default (with ENE it has the most tunnel rows, 33). The other eleven tunnel directions and the field's other fifteen were not run, so nothing here says how the model does at them.

Frame 'literal': the model is probed at the published z in the STL's frame. The readme says z is measured from the tunnel floor and the ground is z - 10 m, but the STL's own ground under all 13 points is 5 m, so the 5, 9 and 20 m planes are probed 10, 14 and 25 m above the STL's ground (height_above_stl_ground in the pairs). The other frame, 'agl' (the STL's ground plus 5, 9 and 20 m), is the other run of this case. Neither is asserted, and the files do not say which one the tunnel meant: the 9 m plane's √(|U|²+2k) scores R 0.93 and FB +0.04 in the literal frame and R 0.94 and FB +0.13 in the agl frame, which is a statement about the datum, not about the model.

Both sides are U/U(500 m): the tunnel's ratio is as published, the model's is over its own approach U(500 m) = 9.862 m/s, probed 1100 m upwind of the centre (0.986 of the imposed 10 m/s). Over the imposed 10 m/s the 9 m plane's √(|U|²+2k) scores R 0.93 and FB +0.05.

The thermistor reads a scalar speed and so does the cup anemometer: the model is scored as |U|, which is the lower bound, and as √(|U|²+2k), the speed of a velocity with the modelled turbulent kinetic energy in all three components, which is the upper bracket (as in Cases C to E).

The field is a year of 10-minute means above 5 m/s at a rooftop reference, over a sector 22.5° wide, at 3 to 11 m above ground; the standard deviation of the means behind each value is 0.075 to 0.15 of U(500 m), 0.20 to 0.78 of the value itself (the horizontal bars of the figure), and a RANS field is one steady state for one exact direction. The tunnel's 9 m column scored as a model of the field, point for point, gives R 0.93, FAC2 1.00, FB -0.01: the bar a model of the tunnel is not expected to clear.

The field values of point 14 are the cleaned table's, realigned with the workbook: the published RS-FO_caseF.csv holds them shifted by one direction (clean/QUESTIONS.md QF1). The field scores here therefore differ from Eddy3D's own results file in the third decimal (√(|U|²+2k) in the literal frame: R 0.8729 here, 0.8731 there; in the agl frame 0.8893 and 0.8872); the tunnel scores are identical to it.

The STL is open along the rim of its 725 m disc (812 boundary edges, one shell, wound inward), which the canvas's pre-meshing pass cannot close (it removed 3 degenerate faces). The mesh has 2,143,488 cells and checkMesh fails one check (43 highly skew faces, maximum skewness 14.8, maximum non-orthogonality 64.8°), so the solve started on the hardened numerics of Eddy3D's mesh-quality tier.

The solve ran to its 2000-iteration limit with the residualControl unmet (no 'solution converged' line); the initial residuals at the last iteration were U_x 1.0e-04, U_y 5.9e-05, U_z 2.6e-03, p 3.0e-05, epsilon 1.0e-03 and k 1.4e-04, and the log has 1,988 'bounding k' lines.

The solved field correlates R 0.93 with the tunnel's 9 m column for the wind from NNW and R 0.08 with its column for the opposite wind, SSE (agl frame: 0.94 and 0.10). A RANS field knows no compass, so this corroborates the reading of the direction labels as the direction the wind comes from (clean/QUESTIONS.md QF9), at this one direction.

The model's U/U(500 m) at the workbook's two rooftop anemometers (SMB 0.85 for |U|, KDD 0.45) is recorded in the results file and not scored: the tunnel's anchors for them exist for the north and south tests only.

metric_meaning.MeanObserved: mean of the measured, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.MeanPredicted: mean of the modelled, normalised quantity
metric_meaning.Fb: fractional bias, 2 (mean_obs - mean_pred) / (mean_obs + mean_pred); positive = model low
metric_meaning.Fac2: fraction of points within a factor of two (harsh near zero for sign-changing V and W)
metric_meaning.HitRate: fraction of points within D = 0.25 relative or W = 0.05 U_H absolute
metric_meaning.GeometricPairs: pairs with both values positive (used for Mg/Vg)
metric_meaning.null: a metric that is undefined for the data (for example Mg and Vg when no pair has both values positive; Fb, Nmse and Nad of a signed velocity component of Case H or I whose observed and predicted means are not both positive)

figures.caption: Case F, OpenFOAM 12 (realizable k-ε), wind from NNW: the tunnel's and the field's U/U(500 m) against the modelled √(|U|²+2k) (filled) and |U| (hollow) over the model's own U(500 m), in two vertical frames (top: the published z in the STL's frame; bottom: the STL's ground plus the instrument height), for the 9 m plane, all 33 tunnel points (planes at 5, 9 and 20 m) and the 13 field observations (bars: the standard deviation of the 10-minute means).

Case F, OpenFOAM 12, wind from NNW: log₂(model / tunnel) of the scalar speed at the tunnel's 13 points of the 9 m plane on the plan of the district (full-scale metres, north up; the arrow is the wind), in the two vertical frames.

results.pairs_columns: frame (literal or agl: the two runs share this file), source (tunnel: the thermistor at 5, 9 and 20 m; field: the cup anemometers), plane_m (the instrument height above ground by the readme's rule: 5, 9 or 20 for the tunnel, 3 to 11 for the field), point_id (the table's); x and y in m and z_published, the height above the tunnel floor in m, full scale (+x east, +y north); z_probe, the height the model was probed at (the published z in the literal frame; the STL's own ground under the point plus plane_m in the agl frame) and height_above_stl_ground, the probe's height above that ground; observed, the cleaned table's U/U(500 m) for wind from NNW, and observed_sd, the standard deviation of the 10-minute means behind a field value; observed_sse, the tunnel's 9 m value for the opposite wind (SSE) at the same point, for the compass control; Umag_model and rms_model, the modelled |U| and sqrt(|U|^2 + 2k) over the model's own approach U(500 m) (U500 in the results file); k_model, k in m^2/s^2
results.reproduce: Eddy3D fixture Eddy3DCli.Tests/Validation/TestAijCaseFContainerE2E (EDDY3D_AIJ_F_DIRECTIONS=NNW, the default) (Shinjuku district, 1:800, wind from NNW, frame literal; OpenFOAM 12 realizable k-ε, numerics level 3, 2000 iterations, 2,143,488 cells, solved 2026-10-18); figures validation/plot_cases_fm_openfoam.py; scores recomputed from the pairs by validation/dispersion_metrics.py; the SHA-256 of every file the snapshot was read from is in its results file, under `sources`
